definitions.short: Jishi , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H3469. Yishi יִשְׁעִי proper name, masculine ( salutary ) — 1 one of the line of Jerahmeel 1Chr 2:31 (twice in verse), ᵐ5 Ισεμιηλ , A Ιεσει , ᵐ5 L Ιεσσαυει. 2 a chief of Manasseh 1Chr 5:24 , ᵐ5 Σεει, Ιες ( ς ) ει. 3 a chief of Judah 1Chr 4:20 . 4 a chief of Simeon 1Chr 4:42 .
